choices.why: A long, low light-cream sofa with slim arms and dark wooden legs gives the calm, warm neutral base the user wants along the right wall.
This 160x230 natural jute rug is large enough to sit under the front of the sofa and the coffee table, and its warm texture softens the dark floor.
It is the only round, all-wood, low and broad table, and its walnut matches the sofa's dark legs without adding metal or black.
This tall rice-paper lantern floor lamp is exactly the serene Japandi piece asked for, giving soft light in the corner by the sofa.

A tall, slender money tree brings vertical greenery to the corner by the balcony glass; no candidate is a large plant already in a ceramic pot, so this one comes in a plastic grower pot, and the only ceramic pot offered is compact and patterned.

answer.why: Cream fabric, walnut, jute, rice paper and one green plant form a short, neutral, warm palette that contrasts gently with the dark floor and white walls, giving the bare, serene living room the user asked for.
